support.notes: Shape charts drawn on a Canvas 2D node by the DOM-free shape engine: legend toggles (controlled hidden), tap to highlight with the canvas tooltip, entry / update animations, sunburst drill-down with onDrill, and a generic ShapeChart taking any shape type's options. No keyboard navigation and no React tooltip content: tooltip.render may only return text. Component tests, H5 tests in happy-dom and the official Taro WeChat SDK compilation fixture pass. Physical-device E2E and other native targets are not verified.

props.name: data
props.description: Nodes: leaves carry a value, parents sum their children

props.name: gap
props.description: Gap between the cells, in pixels

props.name: headers
props.description: Draws the names of the parents above their children

props.name: palette
props.description: Colors of the marks without `color` (defaults to the `--chart-series-1..8` tokens, then the theme colors)

props.name: legend
props.description: Legend; tapping an item hides / shows its slice, stage, series, node, bar, row or level

props.name: tooltip
props.description: Tooltip drawn on the canvas (`render` may return its text); `false` disables it

props.name: format
props.description: Formats the values of the labels and the tooltip

props.name: percentFormat
props.description: Formats the shares (labels, conversion rates, tooltip); `share` is 0-1

props.name: hidden
props.description: Hidden slices / stages / radar series / top-level treemap or sunburst nodes / sankey nodes / radial bars / bullet rows / calendar levels, by index. Makes the visibility controlled: legend taps then only call `onToggle`, whose `hiddenIndexes` should be stored and passed back.

props.name: padding
props.description: Space around the drawing, in pixels

props.name: locale
props.description: Locale of the texts and numbers the chart writes (tooltip rows, accessible names, number and percent formats, calendar dates). Mini-programs have no `<html lang>`: pass the app language

props.name: texts
props.description: Replaces built-in texts of the `locale` (tooltip rows, accessible names, "No data")

props.name: height
props.description: Height of the chart (the legend included); numbers are pixels

props.name: width
props.description: Width of the chart; numbers are pixels

props.name: disableScroll
props.description: Keeps the page from scrolling while a finger moves on the chart

events.name: onHover
events.description: Called when the highlighted mark changes (tap, or the mouse on H5)

events.name: onClick
events.description: Called when a mark is tapped

events.name: onToggle
events.description: Called when a legend item is tapped (or the instance's `toggle()` is called), with the toggled index and every hidden index after the toggle

translationResources.title: Treemap
translationResources.description: Nested rectangles whose areas are proportional to the values: shows at a glance what takes up the most room in a hierarchy (disk usage, budgets, portfolios). Hover or use the arrow keys to highlight a cell; the tooltip shows its path.

basic.title: Nested
basic.description: Parents sum their children and draw their name as a header; onClick receives the path from the root to the clicked leaf.

flat.title: Flat
flat.description: Without children every node is a leaf; gap widens the space between the cells.

market-map.title: Stock market map
market-map.description: Stocks grouped by sector, sized by market capitalization and colored by the change of the day from red to green, like the market maps of finance sites; the change is part of each cell's name.

bundle.title: Bundle size
bundle.description: What a bundle analyzer shows: the modules of a JavaScript bundle by minified size, three levels deep, and the heaviest dependencies listed under the chart.

drill-down.title: Drill-down into a store catalog
drill-down.description: Clicking a category (onClick, using the first name of event.path) replaces the data with its subcategories and brands, and the breadcrumb goes back to the overview. Inside a category a click selects a brand; renderTooltip prepends the category to the path.

cloud-costs.title: Cloud costs with a legend filter
cloud-costs.description: legend={{ position: "top" }} lists the services; hidden and onToggle make the filter controlled, so a Show all button can reset it and the summary can total the services left. renderTooltip shows a resource's share of the whole bill.

live-cluster.title: Live cluster memory
live-cluster.description: The memory used by each pod is refreshed every 2 seconds (setInterval, cleared when the switch is off or on unmount) and the cells resize in place. Pods above 85 % of their limit turn red through their color, and only the list of such pods is announced.

metric-switch.title: Switching the metric
metric-switch.description: The same tree is sized by revenue, orders or profit, so switching the metric moves and resizes the cells instead of redrawing them; format follows the metric. Country names come from Intl.DisplayNames and renderTooltip lists every metric of a country.

TreemapNode.name: Name shown in the cell, the header and the tooltip
TreemapNode.value: Value of a leaf (parents sum their children)
TreemapNode.color: Color of the cell; top-level nodes take the palette when omitted, children without a color get lighter shades of their parent's

basic.title: Basic
basic.description: Parents (with a header) group their children and the area of a cell is its size; a tap calls onClick with the path of the cell.

data.tapCell: Tap a cell to see its size

nested.title: Nested nodes
nested.description: Disk usage by folder: parents sum their children and show their name above them.

flat.title: Flat list
flat.description: One rectangle per region, its area proportional to the population.

props.hideHeaders: Hides the names of the parents above their children
props.height: Height of the chart, the legend included: pixels or any CSS length
props.options: Other engine options (axes, legend, tooltip, palette, format…) merged with the element's own properties; property only
props.instance: The engine instance (minerva-design/charts/core), null until the element is rendered and connected

events.minerva-hover: The hovered (or keyboard-focused) mark changed; detail: { index, name, value, share }, null when nothing is hovered
events.minerva-click: A mark was clicked, tapped or activated with Enter; detail: { index, name, value, share }
events.minerva-toggle: A legend item was clicked (or toggle() called); detail: { index, hidden, hiddenIndexes }

methods.toggle: Hides / shows a slice, stage, radar series or top-level treemap node by index
methods.getRenderer: Backend drawing the shapes (webgpu, webgl2, webgl, canvas2d), null until ready; set it with the renderer engine option
